- Derived the synthetic test world from `script.readWorld(E2E, [changedCard])` with overridden entries for specs 46, 47, and 29 and a fixture deck. # #5120: Patch: follow-up to #5115 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

<!-- jackioh-bot:spot-check-follow-up #5115 -->
The after-merge spot-check of #5115 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45894714262)) found 1 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`cd5380f08472`). `claude-8` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #5115 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `apps/web/src/net/e2e-smoke-selection.test.ts:119`: Nothing tests that specs 46 and 47 are never added (#4092). The partition test's 46/47 assertions would still pass with `NEVER_ADDED` and its `continue` in `reachedSpecs` deleted, because neither spec can be reached by the ids the test uses.
  Evidence: The test only selects `["core-077"]` and `["core-025"]` from the real tree. Scanning the real sources the way `reachedSpecs` does (quoted id or catalog name, quoted fixture deck id): `46-menus-fit-one-screen.cy.ts` and `47-tap-areas.cy.ts` quote no card id, no card name and no fixture deck id, so neither spec is ever in `reached` and `expect(spec.startsWith("46-")...)` cannot fail. The issue lists this as an acceptance item ("46 and 47 are never added"). Specs 46 and 47 weigh 180 s and 200 s, and the owner took them off smoke because each filled a shard. The fix: call `reachedSpecs` (already exported) or `smokeSelection` on a made-up world where 46's and 47's sources quote the changed card and a deck holding it, and assert that neither spec is in `reached`, `added` or `left`, while a third spec quoting the same card is.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

---
